==================
method named self
==================

class T
  def self
    1
  end
end

---

(program
  (class
    name: (constant)
    body: (body_statement
      (method
        name: (identifier)
        body: (body_statement
          (integer))))))

==================
method named self with parameters
==================

def self(a)
  a
end

def self a, b
  a
end

def self() 1 end

---

(program
  (method
    name: (identifier)
    parameters: (method_parameters
      (identifier))
    body: (body_statement
      (identifier)))
  (method
    name: (identifier)
    parameters: (method_parameters
      (identifier)
      (identifier))
    body: (body_statement
      (identifier)))
  (method
    name: (identifier)
    parameters: (method_parameters)
    body: (body_statement
      (integer))))

==================
method named self on one line and without a body
==================

def self; 1; end
def self; end
x = def self; 1; end

---

(program
  (method
    name: (identifier)
    body: (body_statement
      (integer)))
  (method
    name: (identifier))
  (assignment
    left: (identifier)
    right: (method
      name: (identifier)
      body: (body_statement
        (integer)))))

==================
endless method named self
==================

def self = 1
def self(a) = a

---

(program
  (method
    name: (identifier)
    body: (integer))
  (method
    name: (identifier)
    parameters: (method_parameters
      (identifier))
    body: (identifier)))

==================
setter named self
==================

def self=(v)
  @v = v
end

---

(program
  (method
    name: (setter
      name: (identifier))
    parameters: (method_parameters
      (identifier))
    body: (body_statement
      (assignment
        left: (instance_variable)
        right: (identifier)))))

==================
method named super
==================

def super
  1
end

def super(a)
  a
end

(program

==================
method named self beside a singleton method on self
==================

class T
  def self
    1
  end

  def self.build
    new
  end
end

---

(program
  (class
    name: (constant)
    body: (body_statement
      (method
        name: (identifier)
        body: (body_statement
          (integer)))
      (singleton_method
        object: (self)
        name: (identifier)
        body: (body_statement
          (identifier))))))

==================
singleton methods named self and super
==================

def self.self
  1
end

def self.super
  1
end

def self::self
  1
end

---

(program
  (singleton_method
    object: (self)
    name: (identifier)
    body: (body_statement
      (integer)))
  (singleton_method
    object: (self)
    name: (identifier)
    body: (body_statement
      (integer)))
  (singleton_method
    object: (self)
    name: (identifier)
    body: (body_statement
      (integer))))

==================
alias and undef with self
==================

alias self foo
alias foo self
undef self, super

---

(program
  (alias
    name: (identifier)
    alias: (identifier))
  (alias
    name: (identifier)
    alias: (identifier))
  (undef
    (identifier)
    (identifier)))
